_about: How Theographic's 450 events become the events lane. Keys are Theographic eventIDs. Anything titled 'Lifetime of', 'Reign of' or 'Prophecies of' is dropped by the build (the lives, kings and prophets lanes cover them), along with `skip`. Tier defaults: 3 for an event with a parent, 2 without; `tiers` overrides that. `groups` are parents the data lacks (the Gospels and Acts have almost no partOf links), and `reparent` moves members to a new parent; an event in a group or reparent list is a child of it. `overrides` set a better title, a summary, or modern dates (`year`/`end`) where interpolation is not enough: the Acts dates move to the usual conservative chronology (Jerusalem council 49, Paul in Rome 60-62).

groups.title: Birth and childhood of Jesus
groups.summary: From the angel's word to Zechariah to the twelve-year-old in his Father's house.

groups.title: The ministry begins
groups.summary: John's preaching, the baptism and temptation of Jesus, the first disciples, Cana, and the early months in Judea and Samaria.

groups.title: Ministry in Galilee
groups.summary: Capernaum as home: the twelve chosen, the Sermon on the Mount, the parables by the sea, the feeding of the five thousand, and Peter's confession.

groups.title: The road to Jerusalem
groups.summary: He set his face to go to Jerusalem: the feasts in the Temple, teaching in Perea, the raising of Lazarus.

groups.title: The church in Jerusalem
groups.summary: The ascension, Pentecost, the believers sharing all things, and the first arrests, to the stoning of Stephen.

groups.title: The church scattered
groups.summary: Persecution sends the gospel to Samaria, Ethiopia, Damascus, Caesarea and Antioch; Saul is converted and the Gentiles are welcomed.

1.title: Creation
1.summary: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth, and everything in them, in six days, and rested on the seventh.

2.title: Adam and Eve in the garden

3.summary: Adam and Eve eat from the forbidden tree and are driven out of Eden, with the first promise of one who would crush the serpent's head.

5.summary: Cain murders his brother out of jealousy, and is sent away a wanderer.

24.summary: Enoch walked with God, and he was not, for God took him.

39.title: The Flood
39.summary: God judges a violent world with a flood; Noah, his family and the animals are kept safe in the ark, and God sets his bow in the cloud.

53.summary: The whole earth tries to make a name for itself with a tower to heaven; God confuses their language and scatters them.

71.title: The call of Abram
71.summary: At seventy-five Abram leaves Haran for a land God will show him, with the promise that all the families of the earth will be blessed in him.

79.title: Sodom destroyed
79.summary: Abraham pleads for the city; only Lot and his daughters escape.

80.summary: The promised son is born to Abraham at a hundred and Sarah at ninety; his name means 'he laughs'.

105.title: Joseph sold into Egypt
105.summary: Jacob's favourite son is sold by his brothers to traders and taken to Egypt. 'You meant evil against me, but God meant it for good.'

111.title: Joseph made ruler of Egypt
111.summary: At thirty, Joseph interprets Pharaoh's dreams and is set over all Egypt to prepare for the famine.

117.title: Job's trial
117.summary: A blameless man loses everything, argues with his friends, and meets God in the whirlwind. When it happened is unknown; Theographic places it in the patriarchal age.

125.title: The plagues and the Passover
125.summary: Ten plagues on Egypt, the Passover lamb, and Israel walks out of slavery on the night the firstborn die.

127.title: The Law given at Sinai
127.summary: At the mountain God speaks the Ten Commandments and makes his covenant with Israel.

129.summary: Moses sees the promised land from Mount Nebo and dies there, a hundred and twenty years old.

130.title: Crossing the Jordan
130.summary: The river stops while the priests stand in it with the ark, and Israel crosses into Canaan on dry ground.

141.title: Gideon
141.summary: The least in his father's house routs Midian with three hundred men, trumpets and torches in jars.

154.title: Samson destroys the temple of Dagon

157.title: David and Goliath
157.summary: A shepherd boy kills the Philistine champion with a sling and a stone: the battle is the LORD's.

158.summary: Saul and Jonathan die fighting the Philistines on Mount Gilboa.

162.title: Solomon builds the Temple
162.summary: Begun 480 years after the Exodus, in Solomon's fourth year, and finished seven years later.

185.title: Elijah taken up to heaven
185.summary: A chariot of fire and a whirlwind; Elisha picks up the fallen cloak.

254.summary: Jesus is born in Bethlehem and laid in a manger; angels announce him to shepherds.

267.title: The baptism of Jesus
267.summary: John baptises Jesus in the Jordan; the Spirit descends like a dove and the Father speaks.

296.title: The Sermon on the Mount
296.summary: The Beatitudes, the Lord's Prayer, salt and light, and the house built on the rock.

404.title: Peter's confession
404.summary: 'You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.'

443.title: Holy Week
443.summary: From the triumphal entry to the empty tomb: the last week of Jesus's earthly life.

459.title: The crucifixion
459.summary: Jesus is crucified at Golgotha under Pontius Pilate, dies, and is buried in Joseph of Arimathea's tomb.

460.title: The resurrection
460.summary: On the third day the tomb is empty; the risen Jesus appears to Mary Magdalene, to the disciples, and to more than five hundred.

307.title: Pentecost: the Holy Spirit comes
307.summary: Tongues of fire, the gospel heard in every language, and three thousand baptised in a day.

326.title: Saul converted
326.summary: On the road to Damascus a light from heaven, and a voice: 'Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?'

344.title: The Jerusalem council
344.summary: The apostles and elders agree that Gentile believers need not be circumcised.

381.title: Paul's arrest, trials and voyage to Rome
381.summary: Seized in the Temple, tried before the Council, Felix, Festus and Agrippa, shipwrecked on Malta, and two years under guard in Rome.

385.title: Two years in Rome under guard
